name: std::flat_multimap<Key,T,Compare,KeyContainer,MappedContainer>::rend, std::flat_multimap<Key,T,Compare,KeyContainer,MappedContainer>::crend
intro: Returns a reverse iterator to the element following the last element of the reversed flat_multimap. It corresponds to the element preceding the first element of the non-reversed flat_multimap. This element acts as a placeholder, attempting to access it results in undefined behavior.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: Reverse iterator to the element following the last element.
